evidence.title: Vercel Plugin for AI Coding Agents

name: Vercel Plugin for AI Coding Agents
summary: Plugin that gives AI coding tools Vercel context, skills, specialist agents and slash commands.
description: Installable plugin for AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot and VS Code. It ships a Vercel ecosystem knowledge graph, 33 skills, 3 specialist agents and 4 slash commands, with session-start context injected only in empty or detected Vercel, Next.js and eve projects.
contains: 3 specialist agents: deployment, performance, AI architecture
ecosystem graph of Vercel products, libraries, CLI, API and services
session-start context only in empty or detected Vercel, Next.js and eve projects
